chain.rationale: see FC005_DESI_SELECTION.md; v1.2 comparison recorded, not silently mixed

chain.random_catalogue: NOT used -- G_DESI is built directly on data-point positions, no DD/DR/RR estimator; see FC005_DESI_SELECTION.md 'Randoms' section for the full justification

chain.provenance: DESI's own official fiducial cosmology (arXiv:2404.03005), numerically equal to Planck 2018 base-LambdaCDM

chain.formula: chi(z) = c * integral_0^z dz'/H(z'); x=chi*cos(dec)*cos(ra), y=chi*cos(dec)*sin(ra), z_spatial=chi*sin(dec)
chain.note: z_spatial (Cartesian) kept unambiguously distinct from redshift z throughout the codebase

chain.construction: G_DESI = (V,E,W); W_ij = exp(-d_ij^2 / (2*epsilon^2)), weighted by WEIGHT_i*WEIGHT_j

gate1_run.epsilon_rule: 3 x median NN separation at N=3000 (measured), scaled by (3000/N)^(1/3)

chain.verification: symmetric, row-sums ~0 to machine precision, v^T L v >= 0 over 200 random test vectors -- data/desi/dr1/fc005/derived/pilot_run_result.json

chain.C_K: 15.749609945722419 (Gaussian kernel, analytic (2*pi)^(3/2), cross-checked numerically to 5 sig figs)

chain.formula: -Delta_h phi_n = lambda_n phi_n  =>  Spec used here is Spec(-L_tilde), NOT Spec(L_tilde)
chain.sign_convention_note: L_tilde -> Delta_h (negative semidefinite, per the workbook's own DC-009/DC-010); the physically meaningful lambda_n>=0 spectrum for the heat trace is Spec(-Delta_h) = Spec(-L_tilde). This sign flip is applied explicitly in compiler/backends/desi_fc005_pipeline.py::run_mathematical_convergence -- see the in-code comment for the full derivation. This is a bug fix made during Gate 1 execution, not a physics change: it corrects which operator's spectrum is computed, required by the equations exactly as given in the source workbook.
chain.solver: numpy.linalg.eigh (dense); solver_residual < 1e-20 at every (N,eps) point tested

chain.conclusion: Gate 1 (mathematical convergence) FAILED on real DESI DR1 LRG SGC data (0.4<=z<0.6 bin) with the tested (N,epsilon) refinement sequence. Per instruction, Gates 2 (curvature closure) and 3 (physical validation) were NOT entered. No heat trace, no (a0,a1,a2) fit, no curvature residual was computed for DESI -- those remain OPEN, never executed.
